definition: The WESAD Gold dataset is defined by this manifest. It consists of the Silver and Bronze files listed below, identified by their authoritative paths and SHA-256 checksums. No physical copy is made; analysis code should read from the paths listed in each entry. Silver TEMP files contain the cleaned warm-up replacement (NaN at indices 0-3); all other signals are Bronze.

summary.quality_headline: The Gold pipeline resolves the only quality issues found in WESAD. Conformance and plausibility violations fall from 60 to 0 after cleaning the E4 TEMP warm-up artefact. Completeness after cleaning: unintentional missingness = 0.0 (60 intentional removals reported separately). Cross-modal alignment passes the 1.0 s threshold (max residual 0.107 s; timeliness partly assessed: the check cannot detect uniform start-time shifts). All four measured dimensions pass. The framework demonstrates end-to-end detection, documentation, and resolution of a real quality issue.
summary.gold_definition_note: Gold is a manifest, not a physical copy. Each entry points to the authoritative file in Silver or Bronze. The manifest checksums guarantee that any future verification detects accidental modification of any source file.
